**Caves in the terrain graph.** The new terrain generator makes caves: a Cave layer node holds the settings of a cave layer (chambers, tunnels, noodles, ravines, roof, surface entrances, sealed aquifers and a lava floor) and a mask of where its caves go, a Cave biome node paints lush caves, dripstone caves or the deep dark between two heights, and the Cave System composite puts the game's caves under a relief with lush caves under wet ground and the deep dark under the mountains, its densities, depths, water and lava as settings. Volume nodes carve what cave layers cannot: a tunnel along a drawn line, a great hall, cave noise kept to a band of rock, rock added for arches. Apply writes them into the map, keeping the caves painted by hand, and they export as painted caves do.
